considerations.title: The next attestation stamp is added where your certificate was issued
considerations.detail: ADAPT read that your marriage certificate already carries the issuing country's foreign-ministry attestation. The next stamp comes from the UAE mission in that country, and UAE MoFA attests the certificate only after it, so plan the mission step before you fly. Your spouse's residence visa needs the attested certificate.

considerations.title: Your spouse's visa waits on a registered lease, and the lease waits on your own visa
considerations.detail: ICP asks a sponsor for housing that fits the family, shown by a certified lease or proof of ownership. If you rent, that proof is a lease registered in Tawtheeq, and Tawtheeq comes only after these steps: get your Emirates ID and get your residence visa. So your own residence comes first, then a lease registered in your name, then your spouse's visa. Choose a home with room for both of you before you sign.

# Cover letter: sponsoring your spouse

To: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)

Subject: Sponsor a family member's residence visa

Dear Sir or Madam,

I, Kabir Rahman, am applying for Sponsor a family member's residence visa for my spouse, Ayesha Rahman.

Please find enclosed:
- Health insurance policy (spouse)
- Attested marriage certificate
- Medical fitness certificate (spouse)
- Passport (spouse)
- Personal photo (spouse)
- Residence permit
- Employment (salary) certificate
- Adequate housing for the family (spouse)

Yours faithfully,
Kabir Rahman

nodes.summary: Provides lease services (register, renew, modify, close or cancel tenancy contracts) and runs Tawtheeq registration.

nodes.label: Integrated Transport Centre (Abu Dhabi Mobility)
nodes.summary: Provides driver and vehicle licensing, public buses (Hafilat) and the Darb toll system in Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: Federal Tax Authority (FTA)
nodes.summary: Registers persons subject to UAE Corporate Tax and issues Corporate Tax Registration Numbers.

nodes.label: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA)
nodes.summary: One of the government partners behind UAE PASS, the national digital identity.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi Residents Office (ADRO)
nodes.summary: A division of ADDED that supports residents with visa services, guides for residents and Golden Visa nominations.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi Distribution Company (ADDC)
nodes.summary: Delivers water and electricity services in Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: TAMM
nodes.summary: Abu Dhabi Government's one-stop portal for all government services, on the web, in the TAMM app and at TAMM centres. You sign in with UAE PASS.

nodes.label: ICP smart services (website and UAEICP app)
nodes.summary: ICP's online channels for visa, residence and Emirates ID services. Sign-in with UAE PASS.

nodes.label: ICP-registered typing centres
nodes.summary: Offline channel where visa and Emirates ID applications are typed and submitted.

nodes.label: ICP customer happiness centres
nodes.summary: ICP service centres, used for fingerprint and signature capture by appointment.

nodes.label: ICP authorised service providers
nodes.summary: Applications for the establishment card are submitted exclusively through authorised service providers.

nodes.label: MoFA website and UAE MOFA app
nodes.summary: MoFA's attestation channels. Sign-in with UAE PASS.

nodes.label: UAE embassies and consulates abroad
nodes.summary: Attest documents in the country that issued them, where the mission offers the service.

nodes.label: ADGM Online Registry Solution
nodes.summary: ADGM's digital platform to register, incorporate and maintain companies online.

nodes.label: ACCESSADGM
nodes.summary: Portal through which the ADGM Registration Authority processes work permits for employees of ADGM entities.

nodes.label: FTA EmaraTax
nodes.summary: FTA's online platform for tax registration. FTA services are only available through UAE PASS.

nodes.label: Municipality customer happiness centres
nodes.summary: In-person channel for lease-contract services such as registration, renewal and cancellation.

nodes.label: SEHA Disease Prevention and Screening Centres
nodes.summary: The listed eService for regular visa screening in Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: DoH-certified health insurance companies
nodes.summary: Where health insurance policies are bought or renewed.

nodes.label: UAE PASS app
nodes.summary: Register, verify your identity with face recognition, sign in to services and sign documents.

nodes.label: UAE PASS kiosks
nodes.summary: Walk-in kiosks to register or verify a UAE PASS account with an Emirates ID.

nodes.label: Darb portal
nodes.summary: Registration and account management for the Darb road-toll system.

nodes.label: Hafilat card sales points
nodes.summary: Ticket machines, partner outlets and customer service offices that sell Hafilat cards.

nodes.label: Ambulance – 998
nodes.summary: Call 998 for an ambulance from anywhere in the UAE (999 police, 997 civil defence).

nodes.label: AD999 app (Abu Dhabi Police)
nodes.summary: Report a fire, request an ambulance or call the emergency helpline in Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: SEHA doctor and facility finder
nodes.summary: Search for doctors and healthcare facilities in Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi mainland
nodes.summary: Businesses with a standard ADDED economic licence practise across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi Global Market (Al Maryah Island)
nodes.summary: Financial free zone; an ADGM company needs a physical registered office here.

nodes.label: ICP Customer Happiness Center – Khalifa City A
nodes.summary: One of ICP's main service centres in Abu Dhabi, offering fingerprint capture.

nodes.label: Passport
nodes.summary: Valid for at least six months for visa and residence applications.

nodes.label: Personal photo
nodes.summary: Recent coloured photo with a white background (ICAO standard for the Emirates ID).

nodes.label: Entry permit
nodes.summary: Entry permit issued to complete residence procedures; needed to register for visa screening.

nodes.label: Residence permit
nodes.summary: UAE residence permit, issued together with the Emirates ID application.

nodes.label: Emirates ID
nodes.summary: Identity card issued by ICP; a legal requirement for residents.

nodes.label: Medical fitness certificate
nodes.summary: Released after visa screening and sent to ICP.

nodes.label: Health insurance policy
nodes.summary: Submitted by the sponsor when a residence permit is issued or renewed.

nodes.label: Attested marriage certificate
nodes.summary: Proof of kinship for a spouse; foreign certificates are attested abroad and then by UAE MoFA.

nodes.label: Attested birth certificate
nodes.summary: Proof of kinship and age for sponsored children.

nodes.label: Employment (salary) certificate
nodes.summary: Shows the family's monthly income and housing provision.

nodes.label: Registered tenancy contract (Tawtheeq)
nodes.summary: A lease registered in Tawtheeq, Abu Dhabi's register of tenancy contracts.

nodes.label: Proof of owning a residence
nodes.summary: Accepted instead of a lease as proof of housing for family sponsorship.

nodes.label: Company licence
nodes.summary: The company's economic licence (mainland) or ADGM commercial licence.

nodes.label: Trade name certificate
nodes.summary: Issued when a trade name is registered with the economic department.

nodes.label: Initial approval
nodes.summary: Confirms the government has no objection to the business being established.

nodes.label: Business premises tenancy contract
nodes.summary: Lease for the business location, needed for a mainland licence.

nodes.label: Memorandum of Association
nodes.summary: Required for LLCs, limited partnerships, PJSCs and PrJSCs.

nodes.label: Articles of Association (ADGM)
nodes.summary: Model, amended or bespoke articles filed with an ADGM incorporation.

nodes.label: Incorporation resolution (ADGM)
nodes.summary: Resolution appointing signatories and directors (template available).

nodes.label: Signed ADGM office lease
nodes.summary: Lease for the registered office in ADGM, uploaded with the incorporation application.

nodes.label: Establishment card
nodes.summary: Electronic card with the establishment's registered data, issued by ICP.

nodes.label: Corporate Tax Registration Number
nodes.summary: Issued by the FTA on corporate tax registration.

nodes.label: Partnership or investment agreement
nodes.summary: Required for the Green Residence investor category.

nodes.label: Business incubator nomination
nodes.summary: Required for every entrepreneur route to the Golden Visa.

nodes.label: Eye test report
nodes.summary: From a centre approved by the traffic department; needed to open a driving file.

nodes.label: Adequate housing for the family
nodes.summary: Owned or rented housing in proportion to the property's capacity, shown by a certified lease or proof of ownership.

nodes.label: Security check
nodes.summary: Residence visa applicants must pass a security check.

properties.note: ICP runs the security check while processing the application.

nodes.label: Emirates ID application (unified with the residence permit)
nodes.summary: Residence permit and Emirates ID are completed through one unified application.

properties.note: Part of the same ICP application: nothing to do separately.

nodes.label: Free of communicable diseases
nodes.summary: Residence applicants must be free of communicable diseases such as HIV and TB; Abu Dhabi screens for TB with a chest X-ray.

properties.note: Determined by the visa screening; nothing to prepare in advance.

nodes.label: Authorised signatory's Emirates ID or Unified Number
nodes.summary: A valid Emirates ID, or a Unified Number for visitors without one, for one of the authorised signatories.

nodes.label: Apply through the free zone authority
nodes.summary: Free zone companies submit the establishment card request through their free zone authority.

properties.note: For ADGM companies the request goes through ADGM.

nodes.label: Residency directorate approval for foreign investors
nodes.summary: Foreign investors need approval from the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners' Affairs before the initial approval.

nodes.label: Activity-specific approvals
nodes.summary: Some activities need approvals from other entities, such as the Municipality or the Department of Health.

nodes.label: Attested by the issuing country's foreign ministry
nodes.summary: A foreign document is first attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country that issued it.

nodes.label: Document rules for attestation
nodes.summary: The original in Arabic or English (or with an official translation), attested by the right authorities.

nodes.label: Active UAE mobile number
nodes.summary: Needed with a valid Emirates ID to register for UAE PASS as a resident.

nodes.label: Active traffic file
nodes.summary: TAMM licensing transactions need UAE PASS and an active traffic file in the licensing system.

nodes.label: Sponsor's minimum income
nodes.summary: The sponsor earns at least AED 4,000 a month, or AED 3,000 plus employer-provided housing.

nodes.label: Who a resident can sponsor
nodes.summary: A spouse, unmarried daughters, sons under 25, and children with special needs.

nodes.label: A resident authorised signatory (ADGM)
nodes.summary: At least one authorised signatory is a GCC national or holds a valid UAE residence visa.

nodes.label: Activity open to foreign ownership
nodes.summary: Foreign investors may fully own most mainland companies; the Cabinet restricts some strategic activities.

nodes.label: Trade name rules
nodes.summary: Carries the legal-form suffix, respects public morals, is unique and matches the activity.

nodes.label: Investor contribution of at least AED 1,000,000
nodes.summary: For the Green Residence investor category, the contribution to the company is at least AED 1 million in cash or equivalent.

nodes.label: Golden Visa entrepreneur criteria
nodes.summary: An approved pioneering project, a qualifying SME, or a founder of sold projects, nominated by a UAE business incubator.

nodes.label: Minimum age for a car licence
nodes.summary: 18 for cars and light vehicles (17 motorcycles, 20 heavy vehicles, 21 buses).

nodes.label: Licence eligible for exchange
nodes.summary: A valid licence from an eligible country (GCC or designated countries), and the holder is at least 18.

nodes.label: A company licence (Abu Dhabi mainland or ADGM)
nodes.summary: Satisfied by either a mainland economic licence or ADGM incorporation.

nodes.label: Visa screening visit
nodes.summary: Registration, physical examination, blood test and chest X-ray at an approved screening provider.

nodes.label: Emirates ID fingerprints and signature
nodes.summary: Applicants aged 15 and over attend an ICP service centre at their booked appointment.

nodes.label: Visit to the UAE mission
nodes.summary: Needed where the UAE mission abroad does not offer attestation online.

nodes.label: Eye test
nodes.summary: At an optician or centre approved by the traffic department.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi Law No. 23 of 2005 (health insurance)
nodes.summary: Makes health insurance compulsory for expatriate residents and their families.

nodes.label: Reserve a trade name (mainland)
nodes.summary: Register a unique trade name with ADDED, alongside the initial approval.

nodes.label: Get initial approval (mainland)
nodes.summary: Confirms the government has no objection to the business; applied for with ADDED alongside the trade name.

nodes.label: Issue an economic licence (mainland)
nodes.summary: The business licence for an Abu Dhabi mainland company, issued by ADDED through TAMM.

nodes.label: Submit an ADGM business application
nodes.summary: The first online form; the incorporation application opens once it is approved.

nodes.label: Incorporate a company in ADGM
nodes.summary: Register a non-financial company with the ADGM Registration Authority and obtain its commercial licence.

nodes.label: Get an establishment card
nodes.summary: ICP's electronic card holding the company's registered data; needed before sponsoring employee visas.

nodes.label: ADGM work permits and employee visas
nodes.summary: The ADGM Registration Authority facilitates employment visas and issues work permits for ADGM entities' employees.

nodes.label: Register for corporate tax
nodes.summary: All juridical persons subject to Corporate Tax register with the FTA and obtain a registration number.

nodes.label: Golden Visa nomination for entrepreneurs
nodes.summary: A 10-year residence route for entrepreneurs; residents apply for nomination through the Abu Dhabi Residents Office.

nodes.label: Get an entry permit to complete residency
nodes.summary: ICP's entry permit to enter and complete residence procedures; enter within its 60-day validity.

nodes.label: Residency medical screening
nodes.summary: Screening at an ADPHC/DoH-approved centre for residency applicants over 18; the fitness certificate goes to ICP.

nodes.label: Get health insurance
nodes.summary: Compulsory for expatriate residents; employers and sponsors provide cover for employees and sponsored family through DoH-certified insurers.

nodes.label: Get your residence visa
nodes.summary: ICP issues the residence permit through a unified application with the Emirates ID, after entry, medical screening and a security check.

nodes.label: Green residence for investors and partners
nodes.summary: A renewable five-year residence without a UAE sponsor for investors in a UAE business.

nodes.label: Get your Emirates ID
nodes.summary: A new identity card issued with the residence permit; fingerprints and signature at an ICP centre for applicants 15 and over.

nodes.label: Open a sponsor file
nodes.summary: A one-time sponsor file that lets a resident apply for visas and residence for family members.

nodes.label: Get an entry permit for a family member
nodes.summary: Entry permit for a relative to enter and complete residence procedures.

nodes.label: Sponsor a family member's residence visa
nodes.summary: Residence permit for a spouse or children, sponsored by a UAE resident and linked to the sponsor's own permit.

nodes.label: Attest a foreign document at UAE MoFA
nodes.summary: MoFA attests foreign documents such as marriage and birth certificates after they are attested abroad.

nodes.label: Attestation by the UAE mission in the issuing country
nodes.summary: The step between the issuing country's foreign ministry and UAE MoFA, applied for online or at the mission.

nodes.label: Register a tenancy contract (Tawtheeq)
nodes.summary: Landlords register residential leases in Tawtheeq; the tenant provides passport, residence visa and Emirates ID to sign the lease.

nodes.label: Connect water and electricity
nodes.summary: Open a utilities account once the lease is registered in Tawtheeq.

nodes.label: Open a driving licence file
nodes.summary: A traffic file to take driving classes and tests.

nodes.label: Get a driving licence through lessons and tests
nodes.summary: Classes at a driving institute and passing the traffic department's tests.

nodes.label: Exchange a foreign driving licence
nodes.summary: Replace an eligible foreign or GCC licence with an Abu Dhabi licence through TAMM.

nodes.label: Get a Hafilat public transport card
nodes.summary: Pay bus fares in Abu Dhabi; the anonymous card has no prerequisites.

nodes.label: Register your vehicle for Darb road tolls
nodes.summary: Register with the Darb toll system; unregistered vehicles are fined after a grace period.

nodes.label: Create and verify your UAE PASS
nodes.summary: The national digital identity used to sign in to TAMM and federal services; residents register with a valid Emirates ID and a UAE mobile number.

nodes.label: Abu Dhabi Residents Office services
nodes.summary: Smart services for visa applications and enquiries, guides for residents and resident engagement.

nodes.label: Call an ambulance
nodes.summary: Hospitals in the UAE accept medical emergencies for initial treatment.

nodes.label: Find a doctor, clinic or pharmacy
nodes.summary: SEHA's finder for doctors and facilities, and the pharmacy list on TAMM.
